uiborninconfiguration.configuration.spaw: Spawning
How often Born in Chaos mobs appear.
Spawn multiplier
1 keeps Born in Chaos spawns. 0 disables scaled spawns. 2 doubles them. Eggs, commands, spawners and structure mobs are unchanged. Per-mob values multiply this and the result is clamped to 0..8.
Individual mobs
Extra multiplier for one mob, on top of the global one.
Baby Skeleton
1 leaves this mob alone. Multiplied by the global spawn multiplier, then clamped to 0..8. Applies to natural, chunk, patrol and event spawns.

uiborninconfiguration.configuration.stru: Structures
How often Born in Chaos structures are placed in new chunks. Already generated chunks stay where they are.
Structure frequency
1 keeps the datapack spacing. 2 places them about twice as often, 0.5 about half as often, 0 stops new attempts. Group values multiply this.
Structure groups
Extra frequency for one group. Future structure sets without their own slider still follow the global frequency.
Graves
1 leaves this group on the global frequency. Graves include every grave_* set and gravecarrionexe.
Clown caravan
1 leaves this group on the global frequency. Graves include every grave_* set and gravecarrionexe.
